Batch 50 is complete. The two pages, 13 items, proof contracts, coverage, notes, and readiness records are in place. All 13 records are `ready`, non-owner, and match their current dependency hashes.

The batch proves only the finite conditional IID law of bootstrap draws; the conditional bootstrap CLT remains with BCS-48. I also corrected the delete-two example: for the sample mean, delete-two complements and size-two subsets give the same six values by complementation.

Scoped checks passed: dependency levels for all 13 items, proof contracts 13/13, precheck 8/8 proof-bearing items, proof-layout 13 items and 25 steps with zero defects, and rendercheck on all 15 item and page files. Focused dependency and reference checks also passed.

The run-wide dependency-level check remains blocked by 56 empty page inventories in 28 other pairs. Those pairs were left untouched.
